name: Disabled Students' Allowance (England)
description: The Student Finance England/GOV.UK route for support with study-related costs caused by disability, long-term illness, mental health conditions or specific learning difficulties.
intended_use: Check the current England eligibility, application process and support categories for Disabled Students' Allowance (DSA).
audience_or_context: Eligible undergraduate and postgraduate students in England who have disability-related study costs, including students with specific learning difficulties or neurodevelopmental conditions.

claims.text: Disabled Students' Allowance is an England student-support route for eligible students with disability-related study needs, with application and evidence requirements set for the relevant academic year.

uncertainties.text: The evidence does not establish whether an individual student is eligible or what support will be approved.
uncertainties.why_it_matters: A current England application route is not an individual entitlement decision.
reopening_or_reduction_conditions: Check the current academic-year guidance and the student's funding route.
Revisit when Student Finance England changes application or evidence requirements.

limitations: Eligibility, evidence requirements, maximum amounts and application routes can change by academic year.
This resource records the England route; Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have their own student-support arrangements.
A listing does not establish that an individual application will be accepted or that a particular item will be funded.
cost_or_access_notes: GOV.UK guidance and application information are publicly accessible; DSA itself is non-repayable support, but evidence or assessment-related costs can vary depending on the route.
conflicts_of_interest: This is an official government/student-finance route. ND Oracle records current access information without making an eligibility decision for any individual.

provenance.method: GOV.UK Disabled Students' Allowance overview and 2026–27 application guidance checked on 2026-08-28. v1.0 adds one narrow England route claim with separate evidence and uncertainty; no individual entitlement or outcome claim is made.
